document.title: Politburo Session, June 26, 1986
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), Afghanistan and the Soviet Withdrawal 1989 20 Years Later
document.note: The Politburo discusses first results of Najibullah's national reconciliation policy. Gorbachev stresses the withdrawal decision is firm, but the US seems a problem; he proposes early partial withdrawals and pulling the USA and Pakistan to participate more actively.

persons.name: Mikhail Gorbachev
persons.role: General Secretary of the CPSU, chairing Politburo session on Afghanistan policy

mentions.quote: Gorbachev. We have reached a new stage in our relations. There is now a new leadership in Kabul.
Maybe we should invite Najib to Moscow? In short, we have to get out of there.

persons.name: Najib
persons.role: New leader of Afghan leadership in Kabul

mentions.quote: And we need to tell Najib: here is our approach.

persons.name: Andrei Gromyko
persons.role: Soviet Politburo member, participant in session

mentions.quote: Gromyko: It is not our war.
We need to bring some people into the government from the opposition.

persons.role: First Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs of USSR

mentions.quote: Kornienko (the First Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs) has already told him some of this.

persons.role: Soviet official tasked with preparing proposal on Afghanistan

mentions.quote: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the KGB, the Defense Department, and Dobrynin in charge of preparing such a proposal.

events.description: Politburo session discussing Afghanistan: new Kabul leadership, cutting advisers, further troop withdrawals, inviting Najib to Moscow, bringing opposition into government.
Soviet withdrawal of two regiments from Afghanistan, described as a first step.
CPSU Politburo session on Afghanistan, with Gorbachev proposing reduced advisers, a new ambassador, further troop withdrawals and an exit strategy.
Gorbachev proposes cutting the number of Soviet advisers (2500) in half and naming a new ambassador.
Soviet Union withdrew two regiments from Afghanistan as a first step.
Gorbachev proposes withdrawing another 5-10 thousand troops soon and completing withdrawal within two to three years.
Gorbachev assigns the Foreign Ministry, KGB, Defense Department and Dobrynin to prepare a proposal on bringing opposition figures into the Afghan government.
Kornienko told Najib part of the Soviet approach before the session.

key_claims: Gorbachev told the Politburo in June 1986 that the USSR must leave Afghanistan while avoiding the appearance of humiliating defeat.
Gorbachev proposed halving the roughly 2,500 Soviet advisers and naming a new ambassador.
Gorbachev proposed withdrawing another 5-10 thousand troops and completing withdrawal within two to three years.
Gorbachev accused the US of obstructing political reconciliation.
Gromyko said it was 'not our war' and urged bringing opposition figures into the Kabul government.
